sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: The US Food and Drug Administration ordered manufacturers of GLP-1 weight-loss and diabetes drugs, including Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, Zepbound and Soliqua, to add warning labels about nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy. NAION is a rare condition caused by reduced blood flow to the optic nerve, which can lead to sudden and permanent vision loss in one eye.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: An FDA review of clinical trials and studies indicated an increased risk of NAION among GLP-1 users. However, Novo Nordisk and the American Academy of Ophthalmology noted that a direct cause-and-effect link has not been established. Patients taking these drugs often already have separate NAION risk factors, such as diabetes and high blood pressure.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: The American Academy of Ophthalmology advises patients not to stop taking GLP-1 medications without speaking to their doctor, and to consult an ophthalmologist immediately if sudden vision loss occurs.

gist: Google DeepMind has released AlphaGenome 2 to predict genetic variant effects in specific cells.
The model uses large datasets to identify how DNA changes influence different cell types.
Researchers aim to use this granular data to improve drug development and disease understanding.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Google DeepMind has unveiled AlphaGenome 2, an AI model designed to predict how genetic variants affect individual cell types and states. Trained on over 100 million cell profiles, the model provides a more detailed view of gene expression than its predecessor.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Understanding how specific genetic changes impact particular cells is crucial for medical research. By identifying these effects, scientists can better target proteins and cell types when developing new treatments for diseases.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: DeepMind is making the model available for non-commercial research via an API. Future development will focus on incorporating data from multiple species and potentially creating digital simulations of biological systems known as virtual cells.

sections.heading: Why it matters
